network.history_and_native_processing: separate network-isolated namespaces with one refused preflight each
network.on_block: retain failure; no bypass, mirror, retry or token exception reuse
network.redirects: HTTPS huggingface.co and its subdomains or subdomains of hf.co only; normal proxy and TLS

preserved_limits: No historical fit/prediction/rescore or resource reset
No TypeSafe/JEV service, credentials, private repository or production access
No approval or execution slot created during preparation
rights: Dataset card declares CC-BY-SA-3.0 and describes GFDL; public research use proposal only, future dataset/model redistribution unresolved. No ownership of public source text.

selection.on_any_failure: retain failed attempt and stop without fitting or prediction
selection.ranking: SHA256(salt + newline + neutral split/ordinal ID); ascending; source file order pinned
selection.train_partition: first 20 hashes support; next 20 development per class
